objectives_en: Build a before-work checklist for station work and field visits covering supplies, route, reporting contact and explicit pause conditions.

read_sections.body_en:
Ana, 33, is preparing for station work and home visits on a hot day. She needs to check supplies and the route with the midwife.

Arrange for the slippery entrance to be corrected and keep people away from the hazard. Check for the correct sharps container, hand-hygiene supplies and PPE required for the task. Know the safe route and incident contact. If essential protection is missing or a task exceeds training, pause and escalate to the supervisor. Gloves or a mask do not replace removing a hazard when removal is possible.
read_sections.body_fil:
Si Ana, 33, ay naghahanda ng station duty at home visits sa mainit na araw. May mga gamit at rutang kailangan munang suriin kasama ang midwife.

Ipaayos ang madulas na pasukan at ilayo muna ang mga tao sa panganib. Tiyaking may angkop na lalagyan ng sharps, hand-hygiene supplies at PPE na itinakda para sa gawain. Alamin ang ligtas na ruta at contact kapag may insidente. Kung kulang ang mahalagang proteksyon o lampas sa pagsasanay ang ipinapagawa, huminto at iakyat sa supervisor. Hindi pinapalitan ng gloves o mask ang pag-alis ng hazard kung kaya itong alisin.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Prepare controls and equipment; report gaps before undertaking unsafe work.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Ihanda ang kontrol at kagamitan; iulat ang kulang bago magsagawa ng hindi ligtas na gawain.

read_sections.body_en: Before leaving, check weather, slippery paths, dogs and possible threats. Share the route and expected return time; use a buddy system when local protocols call for one. Carry drinking water and plan shade and rest during heat. Do not enter an unsafe situation; arrange an alternative. Report accidents, bites or illness promptly and follow the appropriate referral rather than finishing the household list first.
read_sections.body_fil: Bago lumakad, suriin ang panahon, madulas na daan, aso at posibleng banta. Ipaalam ang ruta at inaasahang balik; gumamit ng buddy system kung itinakda ng lokal na protocol. Magdala ng inuming tubig at magplano ng lilim at pahinga sa init. Huwag tumuloy sa lugar na hindi ligtas; makipag-ugnayan para sa alternatibo. Iulat agad ang aksidente, kagat o pagkakasakit at sundin ang naaangkop na referral, sa halip na tapusin muna ang listahan ng bahay.
read_sections.takeaway_en: A safe route and clear reporting contact matter as much as the visit list.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Ang ligtas na ruta at malinaw na reporting contact ay kasinghalaga ng listahan ng bibisitahin.

read_sections.body_en: Clients arrive in a surge, the room is hot and some PPE is unavailable. As a group, identify tasks to pause, tasks that can be modified and who must decide. Consider staffing capacity and client flow; extra BHW hours should not be the only answer. Propose one safer alternative for supervisor approval.
read_sections.body_fil: May dagsa ng kliyente, mainit ang silid at ubos ang ilang PPE. Sa grupo, tukuyin kung aling gawain ang kailangang ihinto, alin ang maaaring baguhin, at kanino hihingi ng desisyon. Isama ang kapasidad ng staff at daloy ng kliyente; huwag gawing tanging sagot ang dagdag na oras ng BHW. Maglatag ng isang ligtas na alternatibo na dapat aprubahan ng supervisor.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Combined hazards may require changing the work and obtaining the appropriate decision.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Kapag magkakasabay ang hazards, kailangang baguhin ang gawain at humingi ng tamang desisyon.

read_sections.body_en: Fill a card: task and scope; supplies and protection; route and weather; contact and return time; pause conditions. Tell your partner: “There is no soap and a threat on the route.” Explain what pauses and whose decision is needed. Alone, write the response. Before the next visit, confirm the route and contact.

private_notes.notes_fil:
## [purpose] Layunin

Bumuo ng before-work checklist para sa station at field visit na may supplies, ruta, reporting contact at malinaw na dahilan kung kailan magpa-pause.

## [time-materials] Oras at kagamitan

60 minuto para sa pinadali na pagsasanay. Bahagi ito ng 4 oras ng subchapter; ang maikling Read ay hindi kapalit ng buong pagsasanay. Gamitin ang sitwasyon at checklist sa ibaba, papel at panulat. Walang tunay na personal na rekord sa pagsasanay.

## [prepare] Ihanda

Ihanda ang lokal na incident contact, route reporting at buddy-system rules. Gumamit ng kunwaring ruta.

## [opening] Pambungad

May banta sa ruta ngunit mahaba pa ang visit list. Ano ang ligtas na hakbang?

## [steps] Mga hakbang

Basahin ang sitwasyon. Ipakita ang isang halimbawa gamit ang checklist sa Obserbahan. Ipagawa ang pagsasanay sa pares o tatluhan. Magbigay ng tiyak na feedback at ipaulit ang bahaging kailangan pang ayusin. Ibigay ang check bago ipakita ang paliwanag.

## [expected-answers] Inaasahang sagot

Ang ikalawang sagot ay inuuna ang ligtas na paraan at koordinasyon. Ang visit target ay hindi dahilan upang pumasok sa banta; kailangan pa ring alam ang ruta at oras ng balik.

## [misconception] Karaniwang pagkakamali

Itinutuloy ang mapanganib na ruta o gawaing kulang ang proteksyon para lang matapos ang target. Ang checklist ay dapat may desisyon kung ligtas nang magsimula, hindi listahan lamang ng gamit.

## [practice] Gawaing pagsasanay

Punan ang card: gawain at saklaw; supplies at proteksyon; ruta at panahon; contact at oras ng balik; dahilan para mag-pause. Sabihin sa kapareha: “Walang sabon at may banta sa ruta.” Ipakita kung ano ang hindi muna gagawin at kanino hihingi ng pasya. Kung mag-isa, sagutin ang parehong sitwasyon sa papel. Bago ang susunod na visit, kumpirmahin ang ruta at contact.

## [answer-key] Susi sa sagot

2. Iwasan ang banta at ayusin ang alternatibo kasama ang supervisor.

Ang ikalawang sagot ay inuuna ang ligtas na paraan at koordinasyon. Ang visit target ay hindi dahilan upang pumasok sa banta; kailangan pa ring alam ang ruta at oras ng balik.

## [observe] Obserbahan

Kumpleto ang limang bahagi ng checklist; natutukoy ang unsafe task na ihihinto at supervisor na kokontakin; kasama ang heat, route at return-time plan.

Kaya na: Kumpleto ang limang bahagi ng checklist; natutukoy ang unsafe task na ihihinto at supervisor na kokontakin; kasama ang heat, route at return-time plan. Nagagawa kahit hindi pinapaalalahanan.

Kailangan pang magsanay: May supplies at ruta ngunit kulang ang contact o pause condition; ipapunan bago muling magbrief.

Hindi pa: Itinutuloy ang mapanganib na ruta o gawaing kulang ang proteksyon para lang matapos ang target.

Markahan bawat pamantayan ng nagawa / may tulong / hindi pa. Magtala ng eksaktong sinabi o ginawa. Ang feedback ng kapareha ay pagsasanay lamang; ang staff observation ay para lamang sa aktuwal na naobserbahan. Huwag markahang lahat ay kaya na dahil may isang nagpakita.

## [support] Tulong

May supplies at ruta ngunit kulang ang contact o pause condition; ipapunan bago muling magbrief. Maaaring magsalita, magsulat o magpatulong magbasa. Gumamit ng wikang komportable ang kalahok. Panatilihin ang parehong pamantayan.

## [sources-review] Sanggunian at tala sa pagsusuri

Draft para sa pagsusuri. DOH Facilitator Guide: PDF 30; BHW Reference Manual: PDF 21, 22, 23. Ang limang hazard group ay mula sa dalawang pahina ng source table. Suriin ng lokal na clinical trainer ang demo at referral pathway. Ang agarang needlestick evaluation ay sinuri sa CDC noong 25 Setyembre 2026. Nasa hiwalay na review report ang natitirang visual, audio, source at pilot checks. Walang bagong tuntunin sa sertipikasyon.
private_notes.notes_en:
## [purpose] Purpose

Build a before-work checklist for station work and field visits covering supplies, route, reporting contact and explicit pause conditions.

## [time-materials] Time and materials

60 minutes of facilitated practice within the subchapter's 4 hours; short Read completion does not replace that training. Use the scenario and checklist below, paper and a pen. No real personal records in practice.

## [prepare] Prepare

Prepare local incident contacts, route reporting and buddy-system rules. Use a fictional route.

## [opening] Opening

There is a threat on the route but many visits remain. What is safe?

## [steps] Steps

Read the situation. Model one attempt against the Observe checklist. Run the practice in pairs or triads. Give specific feedback and repeat the part needing improvement. Ask the check before revealing the explanation.

## [expected-answers] Expected answers

The second response secures a safe approach and coordination. Visit targets do not justify entering danger; the route and return time still need to be known.

## [misconception] Common misconception

Continues an unsafe route or unprotected task simply to finish the target. A checklist must support a decision about safe starting conditions, not just list equipment.

## [practice] Practice activity

Fill a card: task and scope; supplies and protection; route and weather; contact and return time; pause conditions. Tell your partner: “There is no soap and a threat on the route.” Explain what pauses and whose decision is needed. Alone, write the response. Before the next visit, confirm the route and contact.

## [answer-key] Answer key

2. Avoid the threat and arrange an alternative with the supervisor.

The second response secures a safe approach and coordination. Visit targets do not justify entering danger; the route and return time still need to be known.

## [observe] Observe

Completes the five checklist fields, identifies the unsafe task to pause and supervisor to contact, and includes heat, route and return-time planning.

Ready: Completes the five checklist fields, identifies the unsafe task to pause and supervisor to contact, and includes heat, route and return-time planning. Completes this without prompting.

Needs practice: Lists supplies and route but misses a contact or pause condition; complete these before repeating the briefing.

Not yet: Continues an unsafe route or unprotected task simply to finish the target.

Mark each criterion done / prompted / not yet and record the exact words or action. Peer feedback is practice; staff observations cover only performances actually observed. One demonstration does not establish that everyone is ready.

## [support] Support

Lists supplies and route but misses a contact or pause condition; complete these before repeating the briefing. Allow spoken or written responses and reading assistance. Use the participant’s preferred language while keeping the same criteria.

## [sources-review] Sources and review notes

Draft for review. DOH Facilitator Guide: PDF 30; BHW Reference Manual: PDF 21, 22, 23. The five hazard groups span both source-table pages. A local clinical trainer must review demonstrations and referral pathways. Immediate needlestick evaluation was checked against CDC on 25 September 2026. Outstanding visual, audio, source and pilot checks are in the separate review report. No new certification rule.

read_sections.body_en: The trained user places a used needle or lancet directly into the proper sharps container at the point of use. Do not recap, bend or hand-pass it. Keep it out of ordinary bins and never compress a nearly full container’s contents. Follow its fill line and local replacement procedure. If loose sharps are found, keep others away and obtain trained assistance; do not pick them up by hand.
read_sections.body_fil: Ang ginamit na karayom o lancet ay inilalagay agad ng sinanay na gumagamit sa tamang sharps container sa lugar ng paggamit. Huwag ibalik ang takip, baluktutin o ipasa nang kamay sa iba. Huwag ilagay sa ordinaryong basurahan o siksikin ang laman ng halos punong container. Sundin ang fill line at lokal na pagpapalit ng lalagyan. Kung may nakitang nakakalat na sharps, ilayo ang iba at humingi ng sinanay na tulong; huwag damputin nang kamay.
read_sections.heading_en: A needle is not ordinary waste
read_sections.heading_fil: Ang karayom ay hindi ordinaryong basura
read_sections.takeaway_en: Safe sharps disposal requires the right container and trained handling.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Ang ligtas na pagtatapon ng sharps ay nangangailangan ng tamang lalagyan at sinanay na paghawak.

read_sections.body_en: Infections do not all spread through the same route. During client contact, follow hand hygiene, respiratory hygiene, ventilation and task-appropriate PPE under local protocols. Gloves do not replace hand hygiene. Mosquito exposure calls for bite prevention and attention to breeding sites. Keep the area clean and handle waste safely. Do not mix cleaning chemicals or invent dilutions; follow labels and facility instructions.
read_sections.body_fil: Hindi pare-pareho ang ruta ng impeksyon. Sa pakikisalamuha sa kliyente, sundin ang hand hygiene, respiratory hygiene, bentilasyon at task-appropriate PPE ayon sa lokal na protocol. Ang gloves ay hindi kapalit ng paglilinis ng kamay. Sa lamok, mahalaga ang pag-iwas sa kagat at mga lugar na pinamumugaran. Panatilihing malinis ang lugar at ligtas ang waste handling. Huwag paghaluin ang cleaning chemicals o mag-imbento ng dilution; sundin ang label at facility instructions.
read_sections.heading_fil: Piliin ang kontrol ayon sa panganib
read_sections.takeaway_en: Infection prevention combines appropriate practices, equipment and surroundings.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Ang infection prevention ay kombinasyon ng tamang gawain, kagamitan at kapaligiran.

read_sections.body_en: Ana walks far and often stands for long periods. Plan breaks and changes of position, use comfortable footwear and a supportive chair. Arrange supplies to reduce repeated bending and heavy carrying; ask for lifting assistance. Report pain to the supervisor and seek assessment when needed. Enduring pain is not proof of dedication.
read_sections.body_fil: Mahaba ang lakad ni Ana at madalas siyang nakatayo. Magplano ng pahinga at pagbabago ng posisyon, gumamit ng komportableng sapatos at maayos na upuang may sandalan. Ayusin ang mga gamit upang hindi paulit-ulit yumuko o magdala nang mabigat; humingi ng tulong sa pagbuhat. Kung may pananakit, sabihin sa supervisor at magpasuri kung kailangan. Hindi kailangang tiisin ang sakit upang patunayang masipag.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Safer posture, breaks and sensible carrying are part of work preparation.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Ang ligtas na posisyon, pahinga at tamang pagdadala ay bahagi ng paghahanda sa trabaho.

read_sections.body_en: Ana is asked to make an extra evening visit while already exhausted. Explain what can be done within agreed hours and what needs reassignment. Ask the midwife or coordinator for support and arrange rest. Clear goals and boundaries for volunteer duties help prevent overload. Reporting risk and asking for help are compatible with caring for others.
read_sections.body_fil: May humiling kay Ana ng dagdag na lakad sa gabi kahit pagod na siya. Ipaalam kung anong trabaho ang kaya sa napagkasunduang oras at alin ang kailangang muling italaga. Humingi ng suporta sa midwife o coordinator at magtakda ng pahinga. Ang malinaw na layunin at hangganan ng boluntaryong gawain ay nakakatulong sa pag-iwas sa sobrang pagod. Hindi kabawasan sa malasakit ang pagsasabi ng panganib o paghingi ng tulong.
read_sections.heading_fil: May hangganan ang oras at kapasidad
read_sections.takeaway_en: Reporting excessive workload and setting boundaries are part of workplace safety.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Ang pag-uulat ng sobrang workload at pagtakda ng hangganan ay bahagi ng kaligtasan sa trabaho.

read_sections.body_en: Make five hazard-control cards: sharps–proper container; infection–task-appropriate prevention; body pain–work adjustment and breaks; stress–agreed workload and support; accidents–safe route and avoiding threats. Match them and explain why PPE alone is insufficient. In pairs, ask what must pause when protection is missing. Alone, explain each card aloud. Check one control before the next duty.
read_sections.body_fil: Gumawa ng limang hazard-control card: sharps–tamang lalagyan; infection–task-appropriate prevention; body pain–ayos ng gawain at pahinga; stress–agreed workload at support; aksidente–ligtas na ruta at pag-iwas sa banta. Ipares at ipaliwanag kung bakit hindi sapat ang PPE lamang. Sa pares, magtanong kung anong gawain ang dapat ihinto kapag kulang ang proteksyon. Kung mag-isa, sabihin ang paliwanag sa bawat card. I-check ang isang kontrol bago ang susunod na duty.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Choose controls for the hazard; PPE cannot replace every change needed in the work.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Piliin ang kontrol ayon sa panganib; hindi kayang palitan ng PPE ang lahat ng pag-aayos sa gawain.

## [purpose] Layunin

Ipagpares ang limang hazard group sa angkop na kontrol at ipaliwanag kung kailan ihihinto at ipapaayos ang hindi ligtas na gawain.

## [time-materials] Oras at kagamitan

60 minuto para sa pinadali na pagsasanay. Bahagi ito ng 4 oras ng subchapter; ang maikling Read ay hindi kapalit ng buong pagsasanay. Gamitin ang sitwasyon at checklist sa ibaba, papel at panulat. Walang tunay na personal na rekord sa pagsasanay.

## [prepare] Ihanda

Ihanda ang limang card sa practice. Tiyakin sa local trainer ang PPE at sharps protocol; walang tunay na used sharps sa session.

## [opening] Pambungad

Halos puno ang sharps box. Ano ang dapat ayusin bago magpatuloy?

## [steps] Mga hakbang

Basahin ang sitwasyon. Ipakita ang isang halimbawa gamit ang checklist sa Obserbahan. Ipagawa ang pagsasanay sa pares o tatluhan. Magbigay ng tiyak na feedback at ipaulit ang bahaging kailangan pang ayusin. Ibigay ang check bago ipakita ang paliwanag.

## [expected-answers] Inaasahang sagot

Ang ikatlong sagot ay nagpapanatili ng tamang lalagyan. Ang pagsiksik at ordinaryong basurahan ay naglalagay sa susunod na handler sa panganib. Hindi solusyon ang dagdag na ingat lamang.

## [misconception] Karaniwang pagkakamali

Nagmumungkahi ng recapping, pagsiksik, ordinaryong basurahan o pagpapatuloy nang walang mahalagang proteksyon. Piliin ang kontrol ayon sa panganib; hindi kayang palitan ng PPE ang lahat ng pag-aayos sa gawain.

## [practice] Gawaing pagsasanay

Gumawa ng limang hazard-control card: sharps–tamang lalagyan; infection–task-appropriate prevention; body pain–ayos ng gawain at pahinga; stress–agreed workload at support; aksidente–ligtas na ruta at pag-iwas sa banta. Ipares at ipaliwanag kung bakit hindi sapat ang PPE lamang. Sa pares, magtanong kung anong gawain ang dapat ihinto kapag kulang ang proteksyon. Kung mag-isa, sabihin ang paliwanag sa bawat card. I-check ang isang kontrol bago ang susunod na duty.

## [answer-key] Susi sa sagot

3. Palitan ayon sa fill line at lokal na protocol bago umapaw.

Ang ikatlong sagot ay nagpapanatili ng tamang lalagyan. Ang pagsiksik at ordinaryong basurahan ay naglalagay sa susunod na handler sa panganib. Hindi solusyon ang dagdag na ingat lamang.

## [observe] Obserbahan

Tama ang limang hazard-control pair; pinipili ang pause at escalation kung kulang ang mahalagang proteksyon; hindi gumagamit ng ordinaryong basurahan o reuse para sa sharps.

Kaya na: Tama ang limang hazard-control pair; pinipili ang pause at escalation kung kulang ang mahalagang proteksyon; hindi gumagamit ng ordinaryong basurahan o reuse para sa sharps. Nagagawa kahit hindi pinapaalalahanan.

Kailangan pang magsanay: Ligtas ang desisyon ngunit nalilito ang control para sa dalawang hazard; ipares muli at ipaliwanag ang dahilan.

Hindi pa: Nagmumungkahi ng recapping, pagsiksik, ordinaryong basurahan o pagpapatuloy nang walang mahalagang proteksyon.

Markahan bawat pamantayan ng nagawa / may tulong / hindi pa. Magtala ng eksaktong sinabi o ginawa. Ang feedback ng kapareha ay pagsasanay lamang; ang staff observation ay para lamang sa aktuwal na naobserbahan. Huwag markahang lahat ay kaya na dahil may isang nagpakita.

## [support] Tulong

Ligtas ang desisyon ngunit nalilito ang control para sa dalawang hazard; ipares muli at ipaliwanag ang dahilan. Maaaring magsalita, magsulat o magpatulong magbasa. Gumamit ng wikang komportable ang kalahok. Panatilihin ang parehong pamantayan.

## [sources-review] Sanggunian at tala sa pagsusuri

Draft para sa pagsusuri. DOH Facilitator Guide: PDF 30; BHW Reference Manual: PDF 21, 22, 23; WHO — Occupational infections (https://www.who.int/tools/occupational-hazards-in-health-sector/occupational-infections). Ang limang hazard group ay mula sa dalawang pahina ng source table. Suriin ng lokal na clinical trainer ang demo at referral pathway. Ang agarang needlestick evaluation ay sinuri sa CDC noong 25 Setyembre 2026. Nasa hiwalay na review report ang natitirang visual, audio, source at pilot checks. Walang bagong tuntunin sa sertipikasyon.

## [purpose] Purpose

Match five hazard groups with appropriate controls and explain when to pause work and obtain correction.

## [time-materials] Time and materials

60 minutes of facilitated practice within the subchapter's 4 hours; short Read completion does not replace that training. Use the scenario and checklist below, paper and a pen. No real personal records in practice.

## [prepare] Prepare

Prepare the five practice cards. Confirm PPE and sharps procedures with the local trainer; no real used sharps in the session.

## [opening] Opening

The sharps box is nearly full. What should be arranged before continuing?

## [steps] Steps

Read the situation. Model one attempt against the Observe checklist. Run the practice in pairs or triads. Give specific feedback and repeat the part needing improvement. Ask the check before revealing the explanation.

## [expected-answers] Expected answers

The third response maintains proper containment. Compression and ordinary bins endanger the next handler. Extra caution alone is not a solution.

## [misconception] Common misconception

Suggests recapping, compression, ordinary bins or continuing without essential protection. Choose controls for the hazard; PPE cannot replace every change needed in the work.

## [practice] Practice activity

Make five hazard-control cards: sharps–proper container; infection–task-appropriate prevention; body pain–work adjustment and breaks; stress–agreed workload and support; accidents–safe route and avoiding threats. Match them and explain why PPE alone is insufficient. In pairs, ask what must pause when protection is missing. Alone, explain each card aloud. Check one control before the next duty.

## [answer-key] Answer key

3. Replace it according to the fill line and local protocol before overfilling.

The third response maintains proper containment. Compression and ordinary bins endanger the next handler. Extra caution alone is not a solution.

## [observe] Observe

Matches all five hazard-control pairs, pauses and escalates when essential protection is missing, and does not use ordinary bins or reuse for sharps.

Ready: Matches all five hazard-control pairs, pauses and escalates when essential protection is missing, and does not use ordinary bins or reuse for sharps. Completes this without prompting.

Needs practice: Makes a safe decision but mixes up controls for two hazards; rematch and explain.

Not yet: Suggests recapping, compression, ordinary bins or continuing without essential protection.

Mark each criterion done / prompted / not yet and record the exact words or action. Peer feedback is practice; staff observations cover only performances actually observed. One demonstration does not establish that everyone is ready.

## [support] Support

Makes a safe decision but mixes up controls for two hazards; rematch and explain. Allow spoken or written responses and reading assistance. Use the participant’s preferred language while keeping the same criteria.

## [sources-review] Sources and review notes

Draft for review. DOH Facilitator Guide: PDF 30; BHW Reference Manual: PDF 21, 22, 23; WHO — Occupational infections (https://www.who.int/tools/occupational-hazards-in-health-sector/occupational-infections). The five hazard groups span both source-table pages. A local clinical trainer must review demonstrations and referral pathways. Immediate needlestick evaluation was checked against CDC on 25 September 2026. Outstanding visual, audio, source and pilot checks are in the separate review report. No new certification rule.

read_sections.body_en:
Ana, 33, is in a health-station safety practice. The injury in the next example is simulated; no real needles or body fluids are used.

After a used-needle injury, wash the wound with soap and water. Report immediately to the midwife or designated supervisor and obtain immediate medical evaluation from a qualified provider. Do not wait until the end of the shift or for symptoms. A clinician decides on assessment and any post-exposure treatment. Document the event through the local incident process so the cause can also be addressed.
read_sections.body_fil:
Si Ana, 33, ay nasa safety practice sa health station. Ang injury sa susunod na halimbawa ay simulation; walang tunay na karayom o body fluid sa pagsasanay.

Kung natusok ng ginamit na karayom, hugasan ang sugat gamit ang sabon at tubig. Iulat agad sa midwife o nakatalagang supervisor at kumuha kaagad ng medical evaluation sa kwalipikadong provider. Huwag hintaying matapos ang duty o magkaroon ng sintomas. Ang clinician ang magpapasya sa pagsusuri at anumang kailangan na post-exposure treatment. Itala ang pangyayari sa lokal na incident process upang matugunan din ang dahilan ng aksidente.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Report and obtain immediate evaluation after a needlestick; washing alone is insufficient.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Ang needlestick injury ay iulat at ipasuri kaagad; hindi sapat ang paghuhugas lamang.

read_sections.body_en: Using dummy equipment, show where the sharps container belongs and when replacement is needed. Demonstrate hand hygiene and PPE use/removal following the trainer-approved local protocol. Practice uses no real used needles or body fluids. In a short posture exercise, adjust the chair and bag; avoid painful stretching. The facilitator observes actions rather than relying only on verbal answers.
read_sections.body_fil: Gamit ang dummy equipment, ipakita kung saan dapat naroon ang sharps container at kung kailan kailangang palitan. Ipakita ang hand hygiene at paggamit/pagtanggal ng PPE ayon sa trainer-approved local protocol. Walang tunay na ginamit na karayom o body fluid sa practice. Sa maikling activity tungkol sa posisyon, ayusin ang upuan at bag; huwag gumawa ng masakit na stretch. Ang facilitator ang titingin sa kilos, hindi lang sa pagsagot.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Competence is shown through a safe demonstration within the scope of training.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Ang competency ay nakikita sa ligtas na demonstrasyon sa loob ng saklaw ng pagsasanay.

read_sections.body_en: Ana nearly slips but nobody is hurt. Report the hazard, time, location and control through the local process. After an incident, prepare available information for referral and any applicable benefits process, but paperwork must not delay urgent care. BHW insurance and benefits are not identical; confirm your applicable arrangements with the coordinator.
read_sections.body_fil: Muntik madulas si Ana pero walang nasaktan. Mahalaga pa ring iulat ang hazard, oras, lugar at ginawang kontrol sa lokal na proseso. Kung may insidente, ihanda ang available na impormasyon para sa referral at naaangkop na benefits process, ngunit huwag hayaang maantala ng papel ang agarang pangangalaga. Hindi lahat ng BHW ay pareho ang insurance o benepisyo; kumpirmahin sa coordinator kung ano ang naaangkop sa iyo.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Reporting a near miss creates a chance to prevent the next injury.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Ang pag-uulat ng muntikang insidente ay pagkakataong maiwasan ang susunod na pinsala.

private_notes.notes_fil:
## [purpose] Layunin

Gamit ang dummy equipment, sundin ang trainer-approved safety checklist at ipakita ang agarang reporting at referral response sa simulated needlestick.

## [time-materials] Oras at kagamitan

75 minuto para sa pinadali na pagsasanay. Bahagi ito ng 4 oras ng subchapter; ang maikling Read ay hindi kapalit ng buong pagsasanay. Gamitin ang sitwasyon at checklist sa ibaba, papel at panulat. Walang tunay na personal na rekord sa pagsasanay.

## [prepare] Ihanda

Kumuha ng trainer-approved local checklist at dummy equipment. Walang clinical demonstration kung walang qualified trainer at ligtas na kagamitan. Ilagay ang emergency contact sa practice card.

## [opening] Pambungad

Natusok si Ana ng used needle ngunit walang sintomas. Ano ang gagawin?

## [steps] Mga hakbang

Basahin ang sitwasyon. Ipakita ang isang halimbawa gamit ang checklist sa Obserbahan. Ipagawa ang pagsasanay sa pares o tatluhan. Magbigay ng tiyak na feedback at ipaulit ang bahaging kailangan pang ayusin. Ibigay ang check bago ipakita ang paliwanag.

## [expected-answers] Inaasahang sagot

Ang unang sagot ang tamang sequence. Hindi sapat ang paghuhugas lamang; maaaring maantala ng paghihintay ang time-critical na assessment at treatment. Qualified provider ang magpapasya sa paggamot.

## [misconception] Karaniwang pagkakamali

Humahawak ng tunay na used sharps sa practice, lumalaktaw sa critical safety step o nagpapaliban ng medical evaluation. Ipakita ang ligtas na gawain; sa exposure, agarang tulong ang una at hindi hinihintay ang sintomas.

## [practice] Gawaing pagsasanay

Ipakita gamit ang dummy box kung kailan kailangan ng replacement. Sundin ang lokal na demo checklist para sa hand hygiene at PPE. Pagkatapos, gumanap sa needlestick scenario: sabihin ang unang hakbang, tawagan ang kunwaring contact at ayusin ang agarang evaluation. Sa pares, itala ang anumang delay o unsafe step at ulitin. Kung mag-isa, i-rehearse ang reporting sequence; ang physical demo ay kailangang makita ng trainer. Bago ang duty, alamin kung saan pupunta para sa agarang evaluation.

## [answer-key] Susi sa sagot

1. Hugasan, iulat agad at magpa-medical evaluation kaagad.

Ang unang sagot ang tamang sequence. Hindi sapat ang paghuhugas lamang; maaaring maantala ng paghihintay ang time-critical na assessment at treatment. Qualified provider ang magpapasya sa paggamot.

## [observe] Obserbahan

Nasusunod ang bawat critical step ng lokal na demo checklist; tama ang placement at replacement ng dummy box; agad ang report at medical evaluation sa simulation.

Kaya na: Nasusunod ang bawat critical step ng lokal na demo checklist; tama ang placement at replacement ng dummy box; agad ang report at medical evaluation sa simulation. Nagagawa kahit hindi pinapaalalahanan.

Kailangan pang magsanay: Ligtas ang sequence ngunit nangangailangan ng prompt sa reporting contact; ipaulit hanggang malinaw ang contact at pathway.

Hindi pa: Humahawak ng tunay na used sharps sa practice, lumalaktaw sa critical safety step o nagpapaliban ng medical evaluation.

Markahan bawat pamantayan ng nagawa / may tulong / hindi pa. Magtala ng eksaktong sinabi o ginawa. Ang feedback ng kapareha ay pagsasanay lamang; ang staff observation ay para lamang sa aktuwal na naobserbahan. Huwag markahang lahat ay kaya na dahil may isang nagpakita.

## [support] Tulong

Ligtas ang sequence ngunit nangangailangan ng prompt sa reporting contact; ipaulit hanggang malinaw ang contact at pathway. Maaaring magsalita, magsulat o magpatulong magbasa. Gumamit ng wikang komportable ang kalahok. Panatilihin ang parehong pamantayan.

## [sources-review] Sanggunian at tala sa pagsusuri

Draft para sa pagsusuri. DOH Facilitator Guide: PDF 30; BHW Reference Manual: PDF 21, 22, 23; CDC — Best Practices for Occupational Exposure to Blood (https://www.cdc.gov/dental-infection-control/hcp/dental-ipc-faqs/occupational-exposure.html). Ang limang hazard group ay mula sa dalawang pahina ng source table. Suriin ng lokal na clinical trainer ang demo at referral pathway. Ang agarang needlestick evaluation ay sinuri sa CDC noong 25 Setyembre 2026. Nasa hiwalay na review report ang natitirang visual, audio, source at pilot checks. Walang bagong tuntunin sa sertipikasyon.
private_notes.notes_en:
## [purpose] Purpose

Using dummy equipment, follow the trainer-approved safety checklist and demonstrate immediate reporting and referral for a simulated needlestick.

## [time-materials] Time and materials

75 minutes of facilitated practice within the subchapter's 4 hours; short Read completion does not replace that training. Use the scenario and checklist below, paper and a pen. No real personal records in practice.

## [prepare] Prepare

Obtain the trainer-approved local checklist and dummy equipment. Do not run a clinical demonstration without a qualified trainer and safe materials. Put the emergency contact on the practice card.

## [opening] Opening

Ana has a used-needle injury but no symptoms. What should she do?

## [steps] Steps

Read the situation. Model one attempt against the Observe checklist. Run the practice in pairs or triads. Give specific feedback and repeat the part needing improvement. Ask the check before revealing the explanation.

## [expected-answers] Expected answers

The first response follows the required sequence. Washing alone is insufficient; waiting can delay time-critical assessment and treatment. A qualified provider decides treatment.

## [misconception] Common misconception

Uses real used sharps in practice, misses a critical safety step or delays medical evaluation. Demonstrate safe practice; after exposure, obtain help immediately without waiting for symptoms.

## [practice] Practice activity

Use a dummy box to show when replacement is needed. Follow the local demonstration checklist for hand hygiene and PPE. Then rehearse a needlestick: state the first action, call the simulated contact and arrange immediate evaluation. In pairs, record any delay or unsafe step and repeat. Alone, rehearse reporting; a trainer must observe the physical demonstration. Before duty, know where to obtain immediate evaluation.

## [answer-key] Answer key

1. Wash, report immediately and obtain immediate medical evaluation.

The first response follows the required sequence. Washing alone is insufficient; waiting can delay time-critical assessment and treatment. A qualified provider decides treatment.

## [observe] Observe

Follows each critical step of the local demonstration checklist, places and replaces the dummy box correctly, and reports and obtains evaluation immediately in simulation.

Ready: Follows each critical step of the local demonstration checklist, places and replaces the dummy box correctly, and reports and obtains evaluation immediately in simulation. Completes this without prompting.

Needs practice: Follows a safe sequence but needs a prompt for the reporting contact; repeat until contact and pathway are clear.

Not yet: Uses real used sharps in practice, misses a critical safety step or delays medical evaluation.

Mark each criterion done / prompted / not yet and record the exact words or action. Peer feedback is practice; staff observations cover only performances actually observed. One demonstration does not establish that everyone is ready.

## [support] Support

Follows a safe sequence but needs a prompt for the reporting contact; repeat until contact and pathway are clear. Allow spoken or written responses and reading assistance. Use the participant’s preferred language while keeping the same criteria.

## [sources-review] Sources and review notes

Draft for review. DOH Facilitator Guide: PDF 30; BHW Reference Manual: PDF 21, 22, 23; CDC — Best Practices for Occupational Exposure to Blood (https://www.cdc.gov/dental-infection-control/hcp/dental-ipc-faqs/occupational-exposure.html). The five hazard groups span both source-table pages. A local clinical trainer must review demonstrations and referral pathways. Immediate needlestick evaluation was checked against CDC on 25 September 2026. Outstanding visual, audio, source and pilot checks are in the separate review report. No new certification rule.
